scripts.build: npm run build -w @syllab/contracts && npm run build -w @syllab/extension && npm run build -w @syllab/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @syllab/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @syllab/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run validate:manifest && npm run secret:scan
